description: Searches the Gamealia developer docs bundled with this server (SDK reference, publishing requirements, autotest checks, reject reasons, guides); local and read-only, no login needed. Use it before guessing an SDK call, a policy rule or how to fix a failed check. Searches the developer's locale when those pages exist, else English. Returns the best pages (slug, title, uri, snippet); read a whole page as the resource gamealia://docs/<slug>, or pass read:true to get the top page's markdown.

locale.description: Docs locale, e.g. en or es (default: the developer's locale, falling back to en)

query.description: Free-text search words, e.g. "rewarded ad", "localeChange" or a failed autotest check id

read.description: Also return the full markdown of the best match (default false)

name: gamealia_docs_search
title: Search the Gamealia docs
